title: Humor reduction
summary: Extracts the direction between joke-seeking requests and plain informational requests on the same topics. Ablating that direction reduces forced jokes, puns, and comedy asides.

prompts: Tell me a funny story about a cat that learns to open doors.
Write a comedic sketch set in a dentist's waiting room.
Tell me the funniest thing that could happen during jury duty selection.
Write a ridiculous story about a meeting that could have been an email.

advice: Start at 0.3. Humor is often a surface register, so the check should move quickly; if responses turn stiff, step down to 0.2.
